title: The Killer Animals
description: This Project turns Normal Passive Mobs into hostile ones
body: This Project turns Normal Passive Mobs into hostile ones. You can be wandering around a plains biome and BOOM! A killer animal spots You. After that, YOU ARE DONE FOR. Newer releases coming soon with more mobs.![Killer Cod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8da69209173a5b17f08ac838401c4759f8da203_0.webp)![Killer Geode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91ecec142764f14e2e6645b74977ee256f9fb933_0.webp)![Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8261a99c82dda8060261d9c8a0f80a82981ddcb9_0.webp)![How to craft igniter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/452f3ff0acfbd0f98c9f828e0878a27a5208aa0d_0.webp)<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0rovUGdwZ5A" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
